## Problem

What is broken or missing. Link the issue.

## Approach

What the change does, in a few sentences.

## Alternatives rejected

- Option: why not.

## Risk and rollback

Blast radius. Does this change capabilities, CSP, or IPC commands?

## Verification

- [ ] Tests added or updated for every behavior change
- [ ] `cargo xtask ci` passes locally
- [ ] IPC bindings regenerated and committed, if commands changed
- [ ] New dependencies justified (license, maintenance, what it replaces)
